changes.title: feat(web): serve problem minimaps from R2 instead of inlining them in the docs

commit.message:
task(web): plan minimaps as R2 assets instead of inline SVG

PR #581 inlines the maps and regenerates all 111 problem pages, which is
+43,370/-223,321 lines of SVG blobs for a few hundred lines of layout logic.
Publishing one SVG per instance to static.tspsolver.com beside the datasets
leaves the pages with a frontmatter URL, makes regeneration a one-line-per-page
diff, and keeps the bulk deletion of the existing inline maps in its own commit.

Records the design: gen-problem-minimaps.mjs (staging dir), publish-minimaps.sh
modelled on publish-benchmarks.sh with a shared scripts/lib/r2.sh for the
cf/wrangler client and image/svg+xml, a versioned prefix with immutable caching,
and minimapUrl in frontmatter rendered by the problem page.
